title: Marlowe Rewards Tier Upgrade Entries: Care Desk Reference
content:
## The rule

A Marlowe Rewards membership is upgraded when its tier-qualifying spend reaches the tier qualifying threshold of a tier above the tier held. The agent writes an upgrade that is due and was not written.

- The new tier takes effect on the date it is written.
- It is valid through 31 December of the calendar year that follows the year in which the tier-qualifying spend reached its threshold.
- It is written only while the membership is in status active.

For example, where the tier-qualifying spend reached the threshold in a hypothetical 2025, the new tier is valid through 31 December 2026.

## When the tier is worked out

The tier the membership takes is worked out only after every dispatched order placed under the member's profile within the missing-points request window carries its earning entry on the points ledger.

Put another way: while a dispatched order placed under the member's profile within the missing-points request window has no earning entry on the points ledger, the tier the membership takes is not yet worked out.

## What the write does

The membership's tier becomes the given tier, with today as its start date and the given last day of validity. Nothing else on the membership or its points changes. The member's perks follow the new tier from today.

## Invocation

`write_tier_upgrade_189dabab` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The Marlowe Rewards membership number to upgrade, as shown by the membership lookup | Identifier |
| `variant_name` | The tier the membership moves to | Exactly one of the six tier names listed below |
| `tier_valid_through` | The last day the new tier is valid before the annual review re-evaluates it | A 31 December, in YYYY-MM-DD format |

**Values of `variant_name`:**

| Value | Tier |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | the base tier |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | the second tier |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | the third tier |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | the fourth tier |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | the fifth tier |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | the top tier |

## Return

The tool returns a one-line text receipt. It names the membership, the tier written, its start date and its valid-through date, both in YYYY-MM-DD format. The receipt appearing means the tier was written.
